content: दोहदः, -दम् [दोहमाकर्षं ददाति दा-क] .²1 .³({%a%}) The longing of a pregnant woman; प्रजावती दोहदशंसिनी ते <ls>R. 14. 45</ls>; उपेत्य सा दोहददुःखशीलतां यदेव वव्रे तदपश्यदाहृतम् <ls n="R.">3. 6</ls>, <ls n="R. 3.">7</ls>. .³({%b%}) The desired object itself. .²2 Pregnancy. .²3 The desire of plants at budding time (as, for instance, of the Aśoka to be kicked by young ladies, of the Bakula to be sprinkled by mouthfuls of liquor <ab>&c.</ab>); महीरुहा दोहदसेकशक्तेराकालिकं कोरकमुद्गिरन्ति <ls>N. 3. 21</ls>; <ls>R. 8. 63</ls>; <ls>Me. 78</ls>; see अशोक. .²4 Vehement desire; प्रवर्तितमहासमरदोहदा नरपतयः <ls>Ve. 4</ls>. .²5 Wish or desire in general.
